item.title: Tale of the Tape: Rhino Records' Open-Reel Tape Series
item.description: Tale of the Tape: Rhino Records' Open-Reel Tape Series John Atkinson Thu, 03/05/2026 - 06:00 Show Promo Image Rhino Records, Warner Music Group's back-catalog label, has jumped into the rarified niche of prerecorded reel-to-reel tapes. Under the Rhino High Fidelity brand, the first two titles were announced in October 2025: T. Rex's Electric Warrior and The Yes Album. Both are limited editions; no more than 500 tapes will be made and sold. Tom Fine 0 0

item.description: Ruark Sabre-R loudspeaker John Atkinson Fri, 03/06/2026 - 05:39 Show Promo Image Like many aging American music lovers, my earliest memories include watching the televised supernova that was The Beatles performing on The Ed Sullivan Show in 1964. Immersion in various British pop groups followed, including the melodically graceful Chad & Jeremy, the polished Peter and Gordon, and sentimental pop purveyors Gerry and the Pacemakers.
